news.title: Nvidia CEO's comeback fuels debate over misogyny and impunity for the rich and powerful
news.summary: Just over a year ago, the chief executive officer of an Ohio tech company was forced to resign when he was caught on video embracing an employee at a Coldplay concert. The CEO of McDonald's was among several pushed out over a consensual relationship at the height of the #MeToo movement.
